name: BeanTown Search Intent Insights
author: BeanTown

sections.description:
BeanTown Search Intent Insights logs internal site searches and turns them into actionable analytics. See which terms visitors use, which searches return zero results, and where you should create new content or products.

Perfect for blogs, business sites, and WooCommerce stores that want to improve findability without complex analytics tools.

Features

  • Log WordPress native search queries automatically
  • Dashboard with search volume, top terms, and content gaps
  • Week-over-week trend indicators
  • Search intent opportunity scoring (grouped similar terms)
  • Content ideas from zero-result searches
  • Long search history retention
  • CSV export
  • Optional weekly email digest (sent from your WordPress site)
  • Privacy-friendly — no IP addresses or personal data stored
  • GDPR-friendly by design

How it works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Visitors use your site search as usual
  3. Open Search Intent in your WordPress admin to view the dashboard
  4. Create content for terms with zero results

Privacy

This plugin stores search terms, result counts, post types, and timestamps only. It does not collect IP addresses, user IDs, cookies for tracking, or any other personal data. Search data stays in your WordPress database.

External services

This plugin does not require an external account to work. All analytics features run locally on your WordPress site.

Optional links (user-initiated only):

  • Used when you click pricing / product links in the admin (no automatic data transfer).
  • Website: https://beantownthemes.net/
  • Terms of Service: https://beantownthemes.net/beantownthemes/terms.html
  • Privacy Policy: https://beantownthemes.net/beantownthemes/privacy.html

PayPal (optional donations)

sections.installation:
1. Upload the beantown-search-intent-insights folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install through Plugins → Add New
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  3. Go to Search Intent → Dashboard to view analytics
  4. Optional: configure logging under Search Intent → Settings
sections.faq:
Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes. When visitors search for products, the plugin detects product intent and shows a product intent rate on the dashboard.

Does this require an external account?

No. The plugin works entirely on your server.

Is this GDPR compliant?

The plugin does not store personal data. Search terms alone are generally not considered personal data unless they contain identifiable information entered by users.

What data is stored?

  • Search term
  • Normalized term (for grouping)
  • Number of results found
  • Post types searched
  • Whether the search targeted products
  • Date and time of search

Can I delete all data?

Yes. Enable Remove all search data when the plugin is deleted under Settings, then delete the plugin.
